flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/cart then In this fresh, independent browser session, If the cart lists any items, @v16:"click \"Empty cart\"".
Verify the cart shows "Cart is empty".
Go to http://localhost:3000/ and click the "Add shirt to cart" button exactly 3 times in total.
Do not add clicks based on the cart badge or any other page state.
Open the cart page.
Verify the Settled Tee row shows a quantity of exactly 3 and the cart total is exactly $54.00.
If the cart is empty or the quantity is not 3, the test fails.
Click Checkout.
Verify the checkout summary lists 3 × Settled Tee and the order total is exactly $54.00.
If the checkout page shows "Cart is empty", the test fails.
Click "Place order".
Verify the order confirmation shows a charged amount of exactly $54.00.
A charged amount of $0.00, or any amount other than $54.00, fails the test.

After clicking “Empty cart,” remain on the cart page and confirm the exact “Cart is empty” text before navigating to the shop or clicking any add-to-cart button.

verdict.root_cause: The agent cleared the initial cart but then moved to the shop and clicked “Add shirt to cart” before the required empty-cart checkpoint was safely completed. That broke the required action order and made the later checkpoint unreliable.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the failed run by performing an out-of-order product-add action at step 0-5. The objective required verifying “Cart is empty” immediately after clearing any existing items, before navigating home and adding shirts. The run instead records the shirt-button click before the later cart-empty analysis at step 0-10. The supplied screenshots do show an empty cart after clearing, so there is no corroborated evidence that the product failed to empty the cart; the failure is in the agent's execution/checkpoint sequencing.
